theme._note: Exact design tokens from runsea.run's live design system (see Races/design.html) -- kept 1:1 so this instance's visual identity doesn't change from the engine rebuild. sourceConfig.discoveryConstraints: Only include road races run primarily on paved or tarmac surfaces (5K/10K/half marathon/full marathon distances). Do not include trail running events, off-road ultra-trail races, obstacle course races, or duathlons/triathlons -- if a source page mixes road races with trail or multisport events, extract only the road running ones.

notes: Vertical instance config for 'races' (runsea.run). This file is the ONLY place vertical labels/branding/behavior are read from by shared engine code -- no vertical-specific strings should ever be hardcoded into /src or /scripts. See /config-examples for how the other four verticals (hotels, local-services, courses, event-planning) instantiate the same schema. Do NOT point DNS/CNAME at runsea.run's live production traffic until this engine's races vertical has passed Step 5 review and a manual QA pass.
